baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا ... ٱنفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Immediate sight admits trade or diversion as a rival center; distraction transfers attention, the assembly breaks into pieces toward one attraction, and the abandoned addressee remains the fixed upright point.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight seeing supplies the perceptual intake that starts the centrifugal chain.
Commerce as pursuit of profit supplies the rival attractor.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies the transfer of attention.
Breaking by separation turns departure into a loss of collective integrity.
Leaving a thing in its existing state makes the standing figure the unchanged remainder.
Bodily upright standing supplies the stable axis against the crowd's motion.

changed_reading.before: People leave a speaker when an attractive event appears.
changed_reading.after: A visible rival center converts a gathered audience into fragments while the addressed figure remains as its abandoned fixed axis.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَأَوْا at the opening and the repeated خَيْر comparison near the close
baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory for seeing activates two tempos: immediate ocular capture and reflective consideration. The rush follows the first without the second, while the repeated comparison reopens deliberate choice after capture.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight seeing supplies the fast perceptual event that captures the crowd.
Deliberative consideration supplies the slower perceptual mode absent from the crowd's reaction.
Seeking good through choice turns the closing comparison into restored deliberation.

changed_reading.before: The crowd merely notices trade or entertainment.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a contest between captured sight and considered choice: they see quickly, but the closing declaration asks them to value reflectively.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ ... وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّازِقِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah does not compare objects alone; it compares provisioning accounts. Profit is pursued through commerce, but what is present with God is beneficial good and provision is an apportioned gift, so the visible channel is denied the status of ultimate source.

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking commerce supplies the human ledger of expected gain.
Nearness and presence supply the counter-stock described as being with God.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the criterion that judges both ledgers.
Apportioned giving relocates provision from the market mechanism to the giver.

changed_reading.before: Sacred reward is simply better than worldly amusement and business.
changed_reading.after: Two gain ledgers compete, and the correction distinguishes an economic channel from the source that apportions every gain.

baseline_models.mechanism: Leaving produces a remainder rather than an empty scene. The messenger persists at his station, and the command to speak follows the abandonment, so withdrawal paradoxically exposes the durability of the utterance and its bearer.

activation_trace.role: The trace remaining after departure supplies persistence within abandonment.
Staying at a station gives the remainder spatial and vocational continuity.
Spoken utterance makes the standing remainder active rather than merely stranded.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is passively left behind.
changed_reading.after: The deserted figure becomes a durable speaking remainder whose commission survives the audience's withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening places expansive movement for livelihood inside universal praise and divine ownership. The focus market rush is therefore not an independent economy outside worship; it is a local mobility circuit that mistakes a governed channel for a sovereign provider.

activation_trace.role: Breadth for going and livelihood supplies a cosmic horizon broad enough to contain market mobility.
Ownership and power of disposal place that mobility under a prior possessor.
Profit-seeking trade supplies the local mobility circuit being nested.
Apportioned giving identifies the governing source of the circuit's yield.

structural_cues: 62:1 opens with everything in the heavens and earth oriented to God, while 62:11 closes by naming God the best provider.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal praise, expansive livelihood-motion, ownership, and the focus provision claim; I infer that market traffic is a subordinate circuit within them. A live alternative is that the opening movement image is only a lexical echo and the link is chiefly theological.

changed_reading.before: Divine provision and market profit are two separate alternatives.
changed_reading.after: Market profit is a mobile subchannel inside a divinely owned provision order, and the error is treating the subchannel as sovereign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dispatched messenger teaches a joined written corpus, while the later carrying scene distinguishes bearing a load from carrying an entrusted content. When the focus crowd leaves that messenger standing, its physical movement enacts an interrupted transfer: bodies move, but the message is not borne onward.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and direction supply the originating movement of the teaching mission.
Messenger and message identify what is meant to pass through the audience.
Joining one thing to another makes the taught book a composed content requiring connective transmission.
Bearing a trust or burden distinguishes meaningful carrying from mere transport.
Letting go of the messenger supplies the break in the transmission chain.
Standing in care and maintenance marks the office that remains while its recipients cease carrying.

structural_cues: 62:2 sequences recitation, purification, and teaching; 62:5 repeats carrying three times and negates effective carrying before 62:11 leaves the messenger in place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sent teacher, composed writing, entrusted carrying, and abandonment; I infer a transfer chain whose receiving link fails. The alternative is that 62:5 diagnoses a different community and supplies analogy rather than direct continuity.

changed_reading.before: The focus records discourtesy toward a speaker.
changed_reading.after: The departure is a failed handoff: the audience moves toward goods while refusing to become the carrier of what the standing messenger transmits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier mention of later others who have not yet caught up changes the scale of the focus abandonment. The present audience can peel away, yet the messenger's remaining station keeps a node available for recipients whose attachment is delayed.

activation_trace.role: Later otherness supplies recipients beyond the presently visible crowd.
A later party catching what is ahead supplies delayed attachment to the mission.
A remaining trace prevents the present departure from exhausting the message's future.
Continuing at a station makes the messenger a persistent point for later catching-up.

structural_cues: 62:3 explicitly withholds completion with 'not yet', whereas 62:11 depicts only the withdrawal of the currently present group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delayed others and a messenger left at his station; I infer persistence across audience turnover. A live alternative is that the later others concern communal inclusion without bearing on this particular departure.

changed_reading.before: The deserted messenger signifies a failed audience and a closed scene.
changed_reading.after: The present audience's failure is real but not final: the standing messenger is a persistent transmission node for others who may attach later.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bounty is first described as God's gift and later as something legitimately sought after worship, during renewed spreading. This preserves economic agency while ordering it: commerce can mediate acquisition, but gift precedes seeking and the provider exceeds the channel.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction and gift supply the prior character of the bounty being pursued.
Giving supplies a direction from giver to recipient before any market effort.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the permitted post-prayer outward movement.
Purposeful seeking supplies legitimate human economic agency.
Gift-like bounty identifies what post-prayer seeking actually seeks.
Profit-seeking trade supplies a possible means that the crowd mistakes for the source.
Apportioned gift secures the distinction between provisioning source and commercial means.

structural_cues: 62:4 says the bounty is given; 62:10 commands seeking it only after the prayer; 62:11 repeats trade inside a final provider comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, post-prayer spreading and seeking, trade, and provision; I infer a source-channel distinction rather than a ban on acquisition. The alternative is a simpler ranking of spiritual reward over permitted commerce without a causal provisioning model.

changed_reading.before: The focus opposes worship to commerce as incompatible pursuits.
changed_reading.after: Commerce remains a permitted means of seeking gifted bounty, but it becomes disordered when treated as source or pursued ahead of the worship that orders it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier flight sequence bends attempted escape into encounter, return, disclosure, and accountable action. The focus rush toward visible trade becomes a smaller version of an outbound vector that feels free but remains enclosed by an eventual return to what exceeds sight.

activation_trace.role: Flight and escape supply the outward vector that appears to evade constraint.
Two opposed things meeting reverses flight into unavoidable encounter.
Return to a place closes the apparently open outbound path.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the domain excluded by the focus crowd's visual capture.
Presence with witnessing supplies the visible domain and prevents it from being the whole account.
A delivered report turns motion into something later disclosed.
Intentional action makes the crowd's movement accountable conduct rather than neutral displacement.
Eye-bound seeing supplies the narrow horizon within which the rush appears rational.
The gathering's dispersal supplies the focus ayah's outbound vector.

structural_cues: 62:8 explicitly sequences fleeing, meeting, return, and being informed; 62:11 sequences seeing, dispersing toward, and a claim about what is with God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the closed flight-return arc and the focus rush toward a visible object; I analogize their directional geometry. The live alternative is that the earlier arc concerns death alone and should illuminate urgency without equating commercial departure with escape from death.

changed_reading.before: The crowd makes a short local detour toward a visible opportunity.
changed_reading.after: Its outward rush is enclosed within a larger return-and-disclosure arc, exposing how a visually rational detour can still be directionally mistaken.

context_deltas.mechanism: A raised call gathers people into a shared time and directs them toward vocal remembrance; a seen commercial signal then breaks that gathering. The command 'say' answers visual capture in the same linguistic medium as the earlier call, producing a conflict between signal systems that assemble and scatter attention.

activation_trace.role: Raised voice and calling supply the auditory signal that initiates assembly.
A place, day, or call that gathers people gives the auditory signal a collective effect.
Remembrance running on the tongue supplies the sustained verbal attention of the gathering.
Seeing supplies the competing visual signal that captures attention.
Distraction away from one thing by another describes the transfer between signal systems.
The gathering's dispersal is the social result of the visual signal winning.
Spoken saying supplies the verbal counter-signal after the crowd breaks away.

structural_cues: 62:9 begins the ritual movement with a passive call; 62:11 begins the rupture with active seeing and follows it with an imperative to speak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call, gathering, voiced remembrance, sight, dispersal, and renewed speech; I infer competition between auditory-linguistic and visual-commercial attention. The alternative is that object and timing, not sensory modality, do all the causal work.

changed_reading.before: A more attractive object distracts the crowd from a less attractive speech.
changed_reading.after: Two signal regimes compete: call and voiced remembrance assemble shared attention, while visible commerce privatizes vectors and fractures it; 'say' reopens the verbal channel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context prescribes a choreography: gather, move purposefully, leave exchange, reach completion, then spread. The focus repeats movement but replaces completed release with breakage while the messenger is still standing. The wrong is thus a legitimate activity placed in the wrong phase, producing fracture instead of ordered distribution.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in the wrong time or place supplies the diagnostic category for mistimed commerce.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the required collective starting state.
Purposeful movement toward a goal contrasts with stimulus-driven scattering.
Leaving a thing supplies the commanded suspension of exchange during gathering.
Exchange for a price identifies the legitimate activity that is temporarily suspended.
Completion and coming to an end supply the release condition for outward movement.
Opening and branching outward supply sanctioned dispersion after completion.
Breaking by separation turns outward movement into premature social fracture.
Leaving the messenger in his current state indicates that the outward turn precedes a completed handoff.
His continuing upright posture supplies the unfinished-state marker against the crowd's exit.

structural_cues: The three consecutive conditional clauses in 62:9-11 regulate call-time, post-completion time, and the moment a spectacle is seen.
Trade is suspended in 62:9, economic seeking is reopened in 62:10, and the crowd runs to trade in 62:11 while the messenger remains standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered gathering, suspension, completion, sanctioned spreading, and then breakage around a still-standing figure; I infer that standing marks an incomplete phase and that the misplacement branch diagnoses timing. Alternatives remain live: standing may be simple posture, and the wrong-time/place image from 62:5 may be analogical rather than a direct label for this crowd.

changed_reading.before: The ayah rebukes people because commerce and dispersal are worldly activities.
changed_reading.after: The ayah rebukes premature fracture: commerce and spreading are legitimate after completion, but destructive when a visible signal pulls the assembly out of its ordered phase.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the silver and scattered-fragment branches inside a verb whose local action is dispersal. It remains anchored by that exact root beside repeated trade, but downstream prose should present the crowd-as-coinage image as a material analogy, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تِجَارَةً ... ٱنفَضُّوا and the repeated ٱلتِّجَارَةِ

activation_trace.role: Profit-seeking trade supplies the monetary field around the dispersal.
Silver supplies the material of coin-like value into which the crowd is imaginatively converted.
Scattered fragments give the monetized crowd its broken particulate form.

changed_reading.before: The crowd scatters in order to reach commerce.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, commerce monetizes the social body itself: the gathered people break into silver-like fragments or change drawn back toward exchange.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because the diversion inventory reaches a mill-mouth and throat image. It remains anchored in repeated diversion beside trade and the explicit provider close; render it only as an appetite-and-processing analogy, not as the lexical sense of لهو here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَهْوًا / ٱللَّهْوِ in a verse closing with ٱلرَّازِقِينَ

activation_trace.role: Casting material into a mill-mouth supplies an image of attractions continually fed into an appetite-machine.
The flesh at the far mouth over the throat locates diversion at the threshold of consumption.
Nourishing food supplies the counter-image of provision that truly sustains rather than merely consumes attention.

changed_reading.before: Diversion is an optional pleasure competing with worship.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, diversion is an appetite threshold that demands continual feeding, while the provider close distinguishes what consumes attention from what actually nourishes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the flourishing-market and pricing branches belong to the same root as the messenger's grammatically explicit standing. The contrast remains anchored by قائما beside trade and repeated خير, but prose must keep the syntax intact: the messenger stands literally; the market stands or sets value only as an ironic branch-activated counter-scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا beside repeated تِجَارَة and خَيْر

activation_trace.role: A flourishing market supplies the ironic second thing made to 'stand' by the crowd's departure.
Valuation and pricing turn the standing messenger into a countermeasure against market-set worth.
Skill in modes of earning supplies the practical valuation system being challenged.
Choosing the better supplies the competing criterion of value.

changed_reading.before: The crowd leaves the messenger physically standing so that trade can proceed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, two standings confront each other: the deserted messenger remains upright while the crowd makes the market flourish, and the closing comparison contests which standing sets value.

strongest_changes: The immediate context changes a generic anti-commerce reading into a choreography of gathering, completion, and permitted dispersal; the focus rupture is premature, not proof that trade is intrinsically forbidden.
Giving and bounty distinguish the provider from the commercial channel, preserving legitimate seeking while denying the market sovereignty over provision.
The call/sight contrast recasts the event as competition between signals that gather shared attention and signals that fragment it.
The sent-teacher and carrying sequence makes abandonment a failed message handoff, while later recipients allow the standing messenger to remain a live node beyond the present crowd.
summary.what_was_special: The split seeing inventory preserved a fast-sight versus deliberation model, while the silver/fragments, mill-mouth/appetite, and market-standing branches produced contained material and valuation outliers instead of being audited away.
remaining_uncertainties: The singular feminine destination in إِلَيْهَا may center trade specifically or compress the whole spectacle into one attractor.
قَائِمًا may mark an unfinished discourse or ritual phase, but it can remain a simple description of posture.
The flight-return geometry and delayed-audience persistence are contextual analogies, not claims that their scenes are identical to the focus event.
The material outliers depend on branch resonance and must not displace the local lexical senses.
